name: City Imbiss
kurzbeschreibung: Street Food with a Twist in Schwaz Welcome to City Imbiss in the heart of Schwaz, where traditional Austrian flavors meet modern street food.
beschreibung: The City Imbiss in Schwaz in the Zillertal gateway region stands for freshly prepared snacks and high-quality regional casual dining. Traditional recipes are served with a contemporary touch. The assortment ranges from hearty alpine classics to creative specialty snacks. The friendly team delivers quick, uncomplicated service without compromising on ingredients. The City Imbiss is the ideal spot for a well-earned break during an exploratory tour through Tyrol, with stone-baked pizzas being especially popular among guests.
